lines.en: label makotoinvite1:
I tap on Makoto’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了 Makoto 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: I figure that the two of us know each other well enough at this point that it will be fine for me to start inviting her over.
lines.zh: 我想我俩到这会儿已经够熟了，我可以开始邀请她过来。

lines.en: Of course, there is one glaring issue with that- and its name begins with the letter A.
lines.zh: 当然，这有个显眼的问题——而它的名字以字母 A 开头。

lines.en: If you said Alexander Graham Bell...you’d be wrong.
lines.zh: 如果你说是 Alexander Graham Bell……那你错了。

lines.en: Because the answer is Ami.
lines.zh: 因为答案是 Ami。

lines.en: Ami is the glaring issue.
lines.zh: Ami 才是那个显眼的问题。

lines.en: if invitetip == False:
call invitetip from _call_invitetip
scene noonsky
: Hello?
: Hey, Makoto. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Makoto。你在忙什么？

lines.en: : I’m just getting ready for work. Why? Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 我正准备工作。怎么了？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Why are you assuming something happened?
lines.zh: : 你凭什么假定出了什么事？

lines.en: : Well, you know I have work, so I doubt you’d be calling to invite me over or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你知道我得上班，所以我不觉得你会打电话来是想约我过去什么的。

lines.en: : Does that mean you can’t come?
lines.zh: : 那意思是你不能来？

lines.en: : Wait, wha-?!
I can hear a stack of things falling over in the background. Probably dildos or something because she works in a porn shop.
lines.zh: 我听见背景里一摞东西倒了的声音。大概是假阳具什么的，毕竟她在色情用品店上班。

lines.en: The thought of a stack of dildos falling on top of Makoto is almost enough to make me smile and I have to prevent myself from doing so in order to keep up my manly illusion.
lines.zh: 一摞假阳具砸在 Makoto 身上的画面几乎让我笑出来，而为了维持我男子气概的假象，我得忍住。

lines.en: : You...You’re inviting me over?!
lines.zh: : 你……你在邀请我过去？！

lines.en: : I am. Are you able to get your mom to cover for you or something?
lines.zh: : 是的。你能不能让你妈帮你顶个班什么的？

lines.en: : Um...uhh! Hold on! I’ll go check!
lines.zh: : 呃……啊啊！等等！我去问问！

lines.en: The sound of things falling over is quickly replaced by the sound of Makoto stomping up the stairs to where I imagine her mother is.
lines.zh: 东西倒塌的声音很快被 Makoto 咚咚咚上楼的声音取代——我猜她妈妈就在楼上。

lines.en: This must be the case because there is no other discernible reason for her to be using stairs right now.
lines.zh: 一定是这样，因为眼下她走楼梯实在没有其他说得通的理由。

lines.en: : Mom! I need you to watch the store!
lines.zh: : 妈！我需要你去看店！

lines.en: : I...have to study!
lines.zh: : 我……得学习！

lines.en: if pornshop15 == True:
: What? Can’t you just study in the shop? That’s what you always do.
lines.zh: : 什么？你就不能在店里学吗？你不一直这样吗。

lines.en: : Not today! Today is...different!
lines.zh: : 今天不行！今天……不一样！

lines.en: : But I’m so tiiiiiiiiiiiiired~
lines.zh: : 可我好困好困好困啊～

lines.en: : Mom! Please!
lines.zh: : 妈！求你了！

lines.en: : ...UGH OKAY.
lines.zh: : ……啊啊好吧。

lines.en: : I should probably take inventory anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正我也该盘个货什么的……

lines.en: : THANK YOU.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。

lines.en: else:
: What? Can’t you just study in the shop? That’s what you always do.
lines.zh: : 什么？你就不能在店里学吗？你不一直这样吗。

lines.en: : Not today! Today is...different!
lines.zh: : 今天不行！今天……不一样！

lines.en: : But I’m so tiiiiiiiiiiiiired~
lines.zh: : 可我好困好困好困啊～

lines.en: : Mom! Please!
lines.zh: : 妈！求你了！

lines.en: : ...UGH OKAY.
lines.zh: : ……啊啊好吧。

lines.en: : I should probably take inventory anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正我也该盘个货什么的……

lines.en: : THANK YOU.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。

lines.en: Makoto quickly runs back down (Or up? Probably down) the stairs before bringing the phone back to her ear.
lines.zh: Makoto 飞快地跑回楼下（还是楼上？大概是楼下），然后把手机贴回耳边。

lines.en: : *Ahem*
lines.zh: : *清嗓子*

lines.en: : Sensei? It appears that I will be able to come over after all.
lines.zh: : 老师？看来我终究还是能过去了。

lines.en: : As it turns out, I wasn’t even scheduled to work tonight. What a wonderful coincidence.
lines.zh: : 结果我发现，我今晚根本就没排班。多妙的巧合啊。

lines.en: : But I just heard-
lines.zh: : 可我刚刚听到——

lines.en: : Can you send me your address please?
lines.zh: : 你能把地址发给我吗？

lines.en: : I can probably find it if I check the[school]-register, but this way seems a lot less weird.
lines.zh: : 我查[school]的登记表大概也能找到，但这样看起来没那么怪。

lines.en: : Yes. A lot less weird.
lines.zh: : 是啊。没那么怪。

lines.en: : And also, expect a fight when you get there.
lines.zh: : 还有，等你到了，预计会有一场架要打。

lines.en: : ...Is that code for roleplay or something?
lines.zh: : ……那是角色扮演的暗号什么的吗？

lines.en: : I knew it was strange that you were inviting me over out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 我就说你突然邀请我过去挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : No, I just mean that I can’t imagine Ami will take kindly to seeing you in the house.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是说我想象不出 Ami 会乐意看到你在这屋里。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Should I bring a weapon?
lines.zh: : 我要带武器吗？

lines.en: : Do you...own a weapon?
lines.zh: : 你……有武器吗？

lines.en: : I can find one.
lines.zh: : 我能找一把。

lines.en: : Uhh, no. I think it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 呃，不。我觉得没事。

lines.en: : Just...come over whenever you’re ready.
lines.zh: : 你……准备好了就过来吧。

lines.en: : Will do! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！一会儿见！

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and start making my way home.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，开始往家走。

lines.en: It would be pretty horrible if Makoto gets there first, so I need to...prep Ami in the meantime.
lines.zh: 要是 Makoto 先到那就太糟了，所以我得……趁这功夫先给 Ami 打个预防针。

lines.en: : I’m back...
lines.zh: : 我回来了……

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit1
: Oh, welcome home!
lines.zh: : 哦，欢迎回家！

lines.en: : Would you like dinner now? Or perhaps a bath instead?
lines.zh: : 你想现在吃饭？还是先洗澡？

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit2
: Or maybe...me?
lines.zh: : 或者……我？

lines.en: : None of the above.
lines.zh: : 以上都不要。

lines.en: : Aww, Sensei~ That’s so-
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Sensei～ 那也太——

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit3
: Wait, what?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！

lines.en: : Ami, how much do you love me?
lines.zh: : Ami，你有多爱我？

lines.en: : Obviously a lot!
lines.zh: : 显然非常爱！

lines.en: : Then I’m going to need you to listen very carefully.
lines.zh: : 那我需要你非常仔细地听好。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit4
: Is something going on?...You’re scaring me.
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗？……你吓到我了。

lines.en: : It’s only going to get worse.
lines.zh: : 只会更糟。

lines.en: : Should I...sit down?
lines.zh: : 我要……坐下吗？

lines.en: : No. Stay right there.
lines.zh: : 不。就站在那儿。

lines.en: : What I am about to say is going to shock you. But I need you to know that it won’t change anything between us. Okay?
lines.zh: : 我要说的事会让你震惊。但我需要你知道，它不会改变我们之间的任何东西。好吗？

lines.en: : Um...yeah...Of course.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好……当然。

lines.en: : Are you sure everything is-
lines.zh: : 你确定一切都——

lines.en: : Sometime in the next few minutes-
lines.zh: : 接下来的几分钟里——

lines.en: : Makoto is coming over.
lines.zh: : Makoto 要过来。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit5
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Now, I need you to stay calm-
lines.zh: : 现在，我需要你保持冷静——

lines.en: : It’s so we can kill her, right?
lines.zh: : 是为了杀她，对吧？

lines.en: : You’d obviously never be stupid enough to invite her to our house unless it was to give me an early Christmas present...RIGHT?
lines.zh: : 你显然不可能蠢到把她请到我们家，除非是为了给我一份提前的圣诞礼物……对吧？

lines.en: : It’s...to study.
lines.zh: : 是……来学习的。

lines.en: : To study? Do you really think I’m going to buy that? You’re barely even a teacher.
lines.zh: : 学习？你真以为我会买账？你连老师都算不上。

lines.en: : No, I mean it. It’s just...for me to study...Not her.
lines.zh: : 不，我是认真的。只是……我要学习……不是她。

lines.en: I decide to say the first thing that comes to mind.
lines.zh: 我决定把脑子里冒出来的第一句话说出来。

lines.en: Realistically, I probably could have just lied and told Ami that we were having the house fumigated or something and made her go back to the dorm but...
lines.zh: 实事求是地说，我大概本可以撒个谎，跟 Ami 说我们在给房子熏虫子什么的，把她打发回宿舍，可是……

lines.en: Well, where’s the fun in that?
lines.zh: 嗯，那样有什么意思呢？

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit6
: So, let me get this straight...
lines.zh: : 那么，让我把话说清楚……

lines.en: : You invited Makoto over to our house because you apparently need help studying?
lines.zh: : 你把 Makoto 请到我们家，是因为你显然需要人辅导学习？

lines.en: : Yes. And what’s with all of the italics?
lines.zh: : 是的。还有你那些斜体是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit7
: Does it make you feel weak? Needing the help of a [teenage]girl?
lines.zh: : 这让你觉得软弱吗？需要[teenage]女孩的帮忙？

lines.en: : You and I both know that Makoto is no normal [teenage]girl. She’s superhuman.
lines.zh: : 你我都清楚 Makoto 不是普通的[teenage]女孩。她是超人。

lines.en: : More like super-stupid.
lines.zh: : 更像超蠢。

lines.en: : Good one.
lines.zh: : 说得好。

lines.en: : Oh good. That must be the superhuman.
lines.zh: : 哦好。那一定就是那位超人了。

lines.en: : Why don’t you answer the door, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你不去开门吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You must be eager to learn, right?
lines.zh: : 你一定很渴望学习，对吧？

lines.en: : I need you to promise me that we won’t have to hide a body by the end of the night.
lines.zh: : 我需要你向我保证，今晚结束前我们不用藏尸体。

lines.en: : I’m obviously not smart enough to pull off a murder, so I doubt that will be necessary.
lines.zh: : 我显然不够聪明去完成一场谋杀，所以我觉得那没必要。

lines.en: : Good. I’m glad you understand.
lines.zh: : 好。很高兴你明白。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit8
: THAT WAS SARCASM, YOU JERK! I’M PLENTY SMART!
lines.zh: : 那是反话，你这混蛋！我聪明得很！

lines.en: scene black
I move to the door to let Makoto in.
lines.zh: 我走到门口让 Makoto 进来。

lines.en: Right before I open it, I look back at Ami to make sure she hasn’t gone to the kitchen and grabbed any sharp utensils...
lines.zh: 就在我开门前，我回头看了 Ami 一眼，确认她没跑去厨房抓什么利器……

lines.en: : Hey. Thanks for coming to help me study...
lines.zh: : 嘿。谢谢你过来帮我学习……

lines.en: : Help you study? What are you-
lines.zh: : 帮你学习？你在——

lines.en: : Oh! Y-Yes! Are you...prepared for knowledge?!
lines.zh: : 哦！是……是的！你……准备好接受知识了吗？！

lines.en: : What the Hell is that? Just act natural.
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么鬼？自然点。

lines.en: : Leave me alone! I’ve never been in a boy’s house before! I’m nervous!
lines.zh: : 别管我！我这辈子从没进过男生的家！我紧张！

lines.en: : CLASS...PRESIDENT...
Oh boy. Here we go.
lines.zh: 哦天哪。来了。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit9
: You’ve got some real nerve showing up here, you know?!...
lines.zh: : 你真有种，居然敢出现在这儿，你知道吗？！……

lines.en: : Oh. Hello there, Ami. I seem to have forgotten you lived here.
lines.zh: : 哦。你好啊，Ami。我好像忘了你住在这儿。

lines.en: : I don’t just live here! I take care of my [uncle] here! We’re practically inseparable!
lines.zh: : 我不只是住在这儿！我在这儿照顾我的[uncle]！我们基本上形影不离！

lines.en: Not true. We’re pretty separable.
lines.zh: 不对。我们挺分得开的。

lines.en: : Is that so? Because he didn’t even mention your name when inviting me over today.
lines.zh: : 是吗？那他今天邀请我过来的时候，怎么连你的名字都没提？

lines.en: Also not true. I specifically mentioned that Ami lives here and that this exact thing would likely happen.
lines.zh: 也不对。我特意提了 Ami 住在这儿，而且这种事很可能会发生。

lines.en: : That’s really funny because he’s never mentioned your name literally ever in the entire time I’ve known him.
lines.zh: : 真有意思——我认识他这么久，他从来、从来没提过你的名字。

lines.en: : Actually, that’s wrong. He did say “Wow, that Makoto girl sure is ugly!” this one time while I was washing his back in the bath.
lines.zh: : 其实不对。他确实说过一次「哇，那个 Makoto 姑娘可真丑！」，就是我给他搓背那回。

lines.en: Again, not true. That exchange never happened.
lines.zh: 再说一次，不是真的。那段对话从没发生过。

lines.en: Why must girls always lie when fighting with one another?
lines.zh: 为什么女孩吵架的时候总要撒谎？

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit10
: Oh? Then perhaps I should wash his back tonight and the two of us can have a little discussion about you...
lines.zh: : 哦？那也许今晚我该给他搓背，然后我们俩可以好好聊聊你……

lines.en: : And how your creepy obsession with your [uncle] is teetering on the verge of [incest] which, I’ll have you know, is illegal. Especially with someone who isn’t even-
lines.zh: : 聊聊你对你[uncle]那种叫人发毛的执念，已经踩在[incest]的边上了——我得提醒你，那是违法的。尤其是跟一个根本不算——

lines.en: : Eyes up here, devil-woman.
lines.zh: : 眼睛看这儿，魔鬼女人。

lines.en: : You will look at me when I am talking to you.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说话的时候，你要看着我。

lines.en: : Do I make myself clear?
lines.zh: : 听清楚了吗？

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit11
: Oh, Ami! I forgot you were even there. Sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 哦，Ami！我都忘了你还在这儿。抱歉。

lines.en: : You didn’t forget me! You were just talking about me!
lines.zh: : 你没有忘了我！你刚刚还在说我！

lines.en: : We are arguing! Forgetting me during a time like this isn’t even possible!
lines.zh: : 我们在吵架！这种时候忘掉我根本不可能！

lines.en: : Wait, who are you again?
lines.zh: : 等等，你又是谁来着？

lines.en: : A maid? Gardener?
lines.zh: : 女仆？园丁？

lines.en: : If you don’t mind, I’d like to be left alone with my teacher.
lines.zh: : 如果不介意的话，我想跟我的老师单独待会儿。

lines.en: : He and I have a lot of ground to cover tonight.
lines.zh: : 我和他今晚有很多内容要赶。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit12
: You...thirsty...little...bitch...
lines.zh: : 你这个……饥渴的……小……婊子……

lines.en: Oh, wow. Ami’s even angrier than normal this time.
lines.zh: 哦，哇。Ami 这次比平时还生气。

lines.en: I mean, of course something like this would be bound to happen with Makoto encroaching on her home-turf...
lines.zh: 我是说，Makoto 闯进她的地盘，这种事当然迟早要发生……

lines.en: But I’m starting to worry that the two of them might actually start hitting each other if I don’t step in.
lines.zh: 但我开始担心，如果我不插手，她俩可能真的会动手打起来。

lines.en: Actually, that might be fun to watch.
lines.zh: 其实，那看着可能挺好玩的。

lines.en: Wait.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: I really shouldn’t let that happen.
lines.zh: 我真不该让那发生。

lines.en: If anything happens to Makoto while she’s here, I could get in trouble.
lines.zh: 万一 Makoto 在这儿出了什么事，我可能有麻烦。

lines.en: Makoto’s a smart girl, but I’m pretty sure that even she would have trouble explaining to her mother why she’s coming home with a black eye after studying.
lines.zh: Makoto 是个聪明姑娘，但我敢说，就算是她，也很难跟她妈妈解释为什么「学习」之后会带着一只黑眼圈回家。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit13
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : No, Ami. You can’t hit her.
lines.zh: : 不行，Ami。你不能打她。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit14
: NGH! WHAT IS THIS WORLD COMING TO?!
lines.zh: : 呃啊！这世界到底怎么了？！

lines.en: : Thank you for protecting me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你保护我，Sensei。

lines.en: : To be fair, I don’t think I’d need any protection from Ami considering her arms are essentially oversized noodles, but I thank you nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我觉得我根本不需要被保护——毕竟 Ami 的胳膊基本就是加粗的面条，不过还是谢谢你。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit15
: My arms are not oversized noodles! They’re strong and ready to fight for what they love!
lines.zh: : 我的胳膊不是加粗的面条！它们很强壮，随时准备为自己所爱的东西而战！

lines.en: : Come at me, wench!
lines.zh: : 有种你就来，丫头！

lines.en: : Sensei, where do you keep her leash? I’m thinking it might be safer for all of us if we just chain her up for a little while.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你把她的牵引绳放哪儿了？我想为了大家的安全，也许该把她拴上一会儿。

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t have a leash. Let’s see if this works.
lines.zh: : 呃……我没有牵引绳。看看这招管不管用。

lines.en: : Ami, go to your room.
lines.zh: : Ami，回你房间去。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit16
: No!
: I have exhausted every trick known to me. I’m sorry, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我已经用尽了我所知道的所有招数了。对不起，Makoto。

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: : I suppose it wouldn’t be the worst thing in the world if all three of us were to...study together.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果我们三个……一起学习，那也不算世上最糟的事。

lines.en: : All that matters to me is that I get to spend time with you, Sensei...It doesn’t bother me that we’re not alone.
lines.zh: : 对我来说重要的是能跟你待在一起，Sensei……我们不是独处，我不介意。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit17
: And you never will be alone. Not as long as I live.
lines.zh: : 而你永远也不会独处。只要我活着一天。

lines.en: : Makoto...Miya-whateveryourlastnameis...We are at war.
lines.zh: : Makoto……宫什么的……我们开战了。

lines.en: : It’s Miyamura. And I accept your declaration of war, Ami Aragofuckyourself.
lines.zh: : 是宫村。而我接受你的宣战，荒川「操你自己」的 Ami。

lines.en: : Hey, wait a minute. She and I have the same last name. That’s kind of insulting to me as well.
lines.zh: : 嘿，等等。她跟我一个姓。这对我也有点侮辱性。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit18
: Oh, of course. I’m so sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。我很抱歉。

lines.en: : I’d obviously never ask you to go fuck yourself, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我显然不会叫你去操你自己，老师。

lines.en: : I don’t like the way you said that, Class President.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你说话的方式，班长。

lines.en: : But since I’m an obedient [niece] who will always do whatever her [uncle] wants her to do, I’ll stand down for the time being.
lines.zh: : 但既然我是个听话的[niece]，[uncle]要我做什么我就做什么，我暂时撤退。

lines.en: : So go on. Study. Teach whatever it is you came here to teach him.
lines.zh: : 那么，继续吧。学习。把你来这儿要教他的东西教给他。

lines.en: : But know that I’ll be sitting on his lap the entire time.
lines.zh: : 但要知道，全程我都会坐在他腿上。

lines.en: : No, Ami. You will not be sitting on my lap the entire time.
lines.zh: : 不行，Ami。你不能全程坐在我腿上。

lines.en: scene makotofirstvisit19
: THERE IS NO GOD!!!!
lines.zh: : 根本没有上帝！！！！

lines.en: scene black
Makoto, Ami and I take a seat at the dining room table and, somehow or another, Makoto is able to freestyle-lecture us about the American Civil War.
lines.zh: Makoto、Ami 和我在餐桌边坐下，不知怎么的，Makoto 就这么即兴给我们上了一课美国南北战争。

lines.en: Why that is the first thing she comes up with to solve the issue of our fake studying session, I have no idea.
lines.zh: 为什么我们这场假学习要解决的头一个问题是这个，我毫无头绪。

lines.en: But it happens nonetheless.
lines.zh: 但它就是发生了。

lines.en: Hopefully, she and I will be actually able to spend some time alone here soon.
lines.zh: 希望我俩很快能在这儿真正单独待一会儿。

lines.en: But while Ami is around, I...can’t see that ever working out.
lines.zh: 可只要有 Ami 在，我……看不出那怎么可能实现。

lines.en: Eventually, it gets late and Makoto decides to head home.
lines.zh: 最后天晚了，Makoto 决定回家。

lines.en: I try to see her out but Ami pushes me away and then literally pushes Makoto out of the house.
lines.zh: 我试图送她出门，Ami 却把我推开，然后字面意义上把 Makoto 推出了屋。

lines.en: Either way, I still feel like the two of us managed to grow closer.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我还是觉得我俩又近了一点。

lines.en: Even if it came at the cost of Ami yelling at me for the next half an hour after that.
lines.zh: 哪怕代价是之后 Ami 冲我吼了半个钟头。

label invitetip:
Welcome to the invite over tooltip!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到「邀请上门」说明！

lines.en: In Lessons in Love, you have the option to invite characters over during nights to increase your level with them in either affection or lust.
lines.zh: 在 Lessons in Love 里，你可以在夜里邀请角色上门，提升他们的好感度或情欲等级。

lines.en: Before you’re able to choose, though, you must play through both of the respective character’s invite-over introductory events.
lines.zh: 不过在选择之前，你必须先通关该角色对应的两场「邀请上门」入门事件。

lines.en: The first one will be meant to introduce them to your house-
lines.zh: 第一场是把他们介绍到你的房子——

lines.en: And the second one will be reserved for performing sex acts with/on them!
lines.zh: 而第二场留给你对他们（或跟他们）做性行为！

lines.en: After that, you’ll be able to choose between affection or lust each time you invite them over, and gain a bonus of 3 points in whichever stat you decide on.
lines.zh: 在那之后，每次邀请他们上门都能在好感度和情欲之间选一个，并在所选的那项上额外获得 3 点。

lines.en: You can even change the outfits they wear during the invite-over animations based on how high your affection or lust level is with them!
lines.zh: 你甚至可以根据跟他们的好感度或情欲等级高低，更换他们在邀请上门动画里穿的服装！

lines.en: Invite over events will be colored light blue in the event tracker, so you’ll always know when a new one is available.
lines.zh: 邀请上门事件在事件追踪器里会标成浅蓝色，这样你随时知道什么时候有新的。

lines.en: More are sure to pop up over time.
lines.zh: 随着时间推移，肯定还会有更多。

lines.en: Since I suppose that’s all you really need to know for now, I’ll let you get back to the game!
lines.zh: 既然我想你现在需要知道的就这些，那就让你回到游戏里去吧！

lines.en: Thanks as always for playing!
lines.zh: 一如既往，感谢游玩！

lines.en: $ invitetip = True
